cues: To solve a triangle is to find all six parts, three sides and three angles, from the three you are given.
There are only four patterns of data.
Two sides and the angle between them.
And two sides with an angle that is not between them.
The first three always give exactly one triangle.
text: To solve a triangle is to find all six parts, three sides and three angles, from the three you are given. There are only four patterns of data. Three sides. Two sides and the angle between them. One side and two angles. And two sides with an angle that is not between them. The first three always give exactly one triangle. The last is the troublemaker.
